text:
maria: quick async standup — what I did: landed kernel-prefetch v2 + ran microbench across slot buckets. blocker: seeing p95 bump on the 1k-seq canary. today: narrow repro and either roll back or patch.

aaron: saw that spike on the canary dashboard (https://dash.internal/redwood/canary). looks correlated with slot-size default change. can you paste the bench cmd?

maria: pasted the exact command below — ran twice (canary).
```bash
./bench --model llama2-13b --seq 1024 --warm 50 --iters 200 --batching=continuous --slot-size=64
```

jin: that uses slot-size=64 (new default). try slot-size=32 and check KV hit rate. evictions jumped on my side at the same timestamp. link: https://telemetry.kv/evictions?cluster=canary

maria: re-ran with slot-size=32 — p95 returned to baseline. looks like interaction between slot-size and kv warmup timing. opening PR #4021 to add adaptive slot detection and a flag to opt out. PTAL @sara @lucas

sara: will review later today. quick ask: add a config toggle (disable_auto_adapt) so enterprise customers can pin behavior.

lucas: small nit in the PR about the default threshold math, but overall lgtm. also suggest adding a perf job to the canary pipeline to catch regressions like this. I can add a job.

perf-bot: :warning: perf alert — canary cluster p95 increased 12% at 2026-03-17T09:12Z; related trace ids: trace-9b1a. Auto-notify: eng-runtime oncall.

maria: action items summarized: (1) rollback canary default to slot-size=32 for immediate mitigation (i've pushed a config revert), (2) iterate on PR #4021 with the opt-out flag and threshold tweak, (3) add a canary perf job (thanks @lucas). i'll update the ticket with the microbench outputs.

aaron: once the PR has the opt-out flag and tests, ping for a quick review — will give thumbs. :thumbsup:

maria: thanks y'all — will follow up in the ticket and handoff to ops if we need a full rollback. :rocket:
